VIDEO SCRIPT: VIRTUES IN ISLAM
Grade: Grade 9 · Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Virtues in Islam. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• explain Islamic teachings on observing modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s commandments
• describe ways in which Muslims can practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness as part of faith
• practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in day-to-day life to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)
• value modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness for a morally upright society

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: explain Islamic teachings on observing modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s commandments
• Model 2: describe ways in which Muslims can practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness as part of faith
• Model 3: practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in day-to-day life to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)
• Model 4: value modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness for a morally upright society

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: explain Islamic teachings on observing modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s commandments
• Practise: describe ways in which Muslims can practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness as part of faith
• Practise: practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in day-to-day life to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Virtues in Islam.”
